subject: Avery Health transition brief & kickoff scheduling
summary: Sales-to-CS handoff for Avery Health: scope, SOW, technical contacts, procurement update, and kickoff scheduling. CS owner assigned and 8/20 kickoff proposed.
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Avery Health - implementation scope + SOW (v1.2)

Neha / Tessa,

Putting the Avery Health deal over to CS for implementation planning. Quick context and asks below — full deal + files attached.

Deal snapshot
- ACV: $420k annual (tiered usage), committed start: 2025-09-01
- Primary use: inference for care-coordination triage (chat + embeddings for retrieval)
- SLA: 99.9% (will move to Dedicated after pilot)

What’s included in this handoff
- SOW_v1.2.pdf (attached) — includes milestones, acceptance criteria, and key roles
- Security questionnaire pending (we expect procurement to request vendor evidence)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/987654321

High-level timeline (requested by customer)
- Kickoff (internal + customer): target week of 2025-08-20
- Pilot: 8/20–9/15 (pilot acceptance 9/15)
- GA (production cutover): 2025-10-01

Immediate asks for CS (please confirm by EOD):
1) Ownership: confirm primary implementation lead and secondary contact
2) Resource estimate: expected SOW effort (implementation days) and any preflight dependencies
3) Security: confirm list of artifacts we can provide (SOC2, network diagrams) — procurement will request the security questionnaire

Customer technical contact is Jamie Liu (jamie.liu@averyhealth.com) — I’ll loop in their infra lead once we confirm kickoff. Procurement is also looped and will push a PO + DocuSign after minor redlines.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOW_v1.2.pdf (PDF, 460KB)]

Thanks — I’m available on the 15:00 PT slot for a quick sync if helpful.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Avery Health - implementation scope + SOW (v1.2)

Karthik — thanks for the context and the SOW. Quick confirmation and a couple follow-ups: 

1) I’ll take point on the implementation intake and scheduling. I’ll own the kickoff facilitation and the milestone tracking.
2) Can you please confirm the customer’s technical lead (for network/VPC setup) and provide any sample environment specs (expected QPS, model choice, and token throughput)?
3) Procurement: will they require an updated security questionnaire or supporting artifacts? If so please attach — otherwise I’ll start with SOC2 + data-flow diagrams.

I see SOW_v1.2 attached. I’ll review and raise any redlines by EOD Monday. If procurement needs the DocuSign envelope soon, ping me and I’ll identify any redlines that impact implementation dates.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60 min kickoff with customer + product engineering + CS. I’m free Tue/Wed mornings next week (8/19-8/20).

—Neha
Neha Kapoor | Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0222

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@averyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Avery Health - implementation scope + SOW (v1.2)

Neha — thanks. Adding a couple items here that just came through from the customer and procurement: 

Customer technical contact:
- Carlos Mendes, Infra Lead (carlos.m@averyhealth.com) — primary for network & SSO setup.

Environment & scale notes (from pre-sales run):
- Expected concurrent sessions: ~150 during peak (chat), avg token length ~320
- Initial model: open-llama-13B quantized; customer is ok with Redwood-managed hosted for pilot

Procurement / legal 
- They requested our completed security questionnaire and a copy of SOC2. I’ve attached the current questionnaire draft — procurement indicated they will return a PO + DocuSign after we agree on the SOW redlines.
- DocuSign envelope will route to Jamie + procurement after redlines; Karthik will share the envelope link once legal confirms.

Actionable items I’m handing over: 
- SOW_v1.2 (attached) — please confirm milestone dates and acceptance steps
- Security questionnaire attached: security-questionnaire.xlsx [Attachment stub]
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/987654321

I’ll be available for the kickoff on 8/20 — happy to join the first 30 minutes to cover deal background.

—Karthik
[Attachment: security-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation owner assignment & kickoff invite (Avery Health)

Looping back with internal assignments and a proposed kickoff slot. Thanks for the handoff — I’ll run the implementation once Neha confirms resource availability.

Implementation owner (internal):
- Primary: Tessa Morgan — Implementation Lead (tessa.morgan@redwood.ai)
- Backup: Ben Carter — Technical Solutions (ben.carter@redwood.ai)

Planned first-call (customer-facing)
- Proposed: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET — 60 minutes (kickoff with Avery: product, infra, and procurement)
- Agenda (30/30): 30 min customer goals + SOW walkthrough; 30 min tech preflight & network/SSO checklist

Internal preflight (items we need before or during kickoff):
- Completed security questionnaire (procurement) — Karthik to confirm return timeline
- Customer VPC/network contact + IP allowlist window — Carlos Mendes
- API keys & access model for pilot (temporary keys + rotation plan)
- Acceptance criteria sign-off: pilot test cases + success metrics (example: 95% availability during 1-week smoke test)

Internal notes (Tessa -> Neha):
- I estimate 6 implementation days for pilot readiness (networking, sample ingestion, prompt templates, smoke tests).
- If procurement requests a delay around redlines we’ll adjust pilot start; flag anything that changes the 9/1 committed start.

Next steps:
1) Neha: confirm kickoff participants and approve the 8/20 14:00 PT slot
2) Karthik: share final DocuSign envelope link once redlines resolved (I’ll review SOW sections for feasibility)
3) Ben: prep an infra checklist and quickrun playbook for the kickoff (IP ranges, sample dataset format, model pipeline notes)

I’ll send a calendar invite once Neha confirms time.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0266
